# StackScope

StackScope is a job market intelligence tool for South African developers.

## What it does

Scrapes live job postings across South Africa, extracts skill frequency across the corpus, tracks what is trending, and scores a developer's skill stack against the current market using TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity.

## Who it is for

CS students and developers in South Africa figuring out what skills to learn and which roles to target.

## Stack

- Backend: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL (Supabase), scikit-learn
- Frontend: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Chart.js
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render (API)

## Live

https://stack-scope-eight.vercel.app
